description: This file defines the TalkModeRuntime actor responsible for managing voice recognition, speech synthesis, and related configurations within the application's talk mode. It handles speech recognition, silence detection, TTS playback (including integration with ElevenLabs and system voices), and maintains state related to voice and model overrides, configuration fetching, and audio level monitoring.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing speech recognition, speech synthesis, and configuration of talk mode functionalities, including handling voice input, TTS playback (via ElevenLabs or system voices), and maintaining state.

classes.name: RMSMeter
classes.description: A helper class for measuring RMS audio levels in a thread-safe way.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode runtime, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the talk mode runtime, stopping or starting recognition as needed.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates the noise floor and detects speech energy based on RMS levels.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles playback of assistant's generated responses, choosing between ElevenLabs TTS or system voices.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops current speech output, whether PCM or MP3, and updates the phase accordingly.
